label: final copy step of length-3 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and overwhelmingly in L=3 sequences (94% of mass). The strongest activations are at the last copy step (t=5, outputting the third original token; input = second original token). On dev, L==3 & t==5 gives precision 0.83, recall 0.65, F1 0.73, mass recall 0.85. Weaker activations come at the first copy step of L=3 (t=4), and sparse weak firing at the second-to-last/last copy steps of longer sequences (to_go<=1, recall_idx 5 etc.). About 17% of L=3 last steps do not fire. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or on the first occurrence of a token (in_first=0 always). Token identity only modulates it a little (g/q/n inputs fire a bit more).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=6: g, q, n, l; t=12: n, g, q, l; t=7: q, g, l, n) and the token being output (most: c, j, a, v, 0, g; least: r, k, d, -); timing cues that raise it most: L=3, L=3 & t=5, L=3 & t=4.
